findings.message: Since PHP 7.0, functions inspecting arguments, like func_get_args(), no longer report the original value as passed to a parameter, but will instead provide the current value. The parameter "$value" was changed on line 144. (behaviour change since PHP 7.0: the code still runs, but func_get_args() and similar may report a changed value)
